findings.summary: Eligible ABSENT still centers on an intentional non-breathing interval and does not hard-separate no-human / no-physiological-source observations from human-present non-detection or apnea-proxy intervals.
Final lock omits required window_id, class_assignment_reason, creation_timestamp, and software provenance before candidate-output access.
Recording quotas are fixed, but within-recording ABSENT context selection has no predeclared deterministic schedule, allowing easy-negative cherry-picking before lock.
Machine-readable wording forbids replacement only after campaign close, which can authorize during-campaign replacement or reallocation.
Acquisition lock does not forbid fitting or refreshing preprocessing statistics, caches, or derived artifacts on final-membership recordings before lock.
